The paragraph describes a bank implementing background checks on new employees in accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA). This action is compliant with legal standards, as the FCRA regulates the collection, dissemination, and use of consumer credit information, including the requirements for employers to obtain consent and provide proper notices before conducting background checks. The stated goal of ensuring compliance with federal regulations through this policy is legally sound.
